title: As revelation grew clearer, the Scripture corpus and Canon grew
source_text: XXVII. Crescente vero doctrinae caelestis claritate, & amplitudine, crevit quoque Scripturarum corpus. Nam prout Deus, juxta varia Ecclesiae suae curricula, aliquid de novo Prophetis & Apostolis revelavit, illud summatim scripto tradiderunt. Unde procedente tempore auctus est Scripturae Canon.
pass_a_gloss: But as the clarity and amplitude of heavenly doctrine grew, the body of the Scriptures also grew. For as God, according to the various courses of his Church, revealed something anew to the Prophets and Apostles, they handed it down in writing in summary. Whence as time went on the Canon of Scripture was increased.
pass_b_english: As heavenly teaching grew clearer and wider, the body of the Scriptures grew with it.
When God, along the Church's changing courses, revealed something new to the Prophets and Apostles, they put it down in writing in summary. So as time went on, the Canon of Scripture was enlarged.

lemmas.gloss: the Canon of Scripture was increased

choices.why: Compact written deposit of new revelation.
